title: Ilajide Unveils Phenomenal New Single “BACKHAND”
htmlContent:
Detroit’s Ilajide has never been one to follow trends – he sets them. As a producer, rapper, and member of the acclaimed hip-hop collective Clear Soul Forces, he’s spent years crafting a sound that’s deeply rooted in Detroit’s musical legacy while pushing boundaries in his own unique way. His latest single, “BACKHAND”, is another testament to his ability to blend raw lyricism with innovative production.

The second single from his upcoming album, Pocket Jams 2 (due out April 20th), “BACKHAND” follows the success of “SLIDE,” giving fans another taste of Ilajide’s ever-evolving artistry. This time, he delivers a track that fuses hip-hop, funk, R&B, and house influences, all while sending a clear message: if you’re not bringing value to the table, you might just get hit with the backhand.

Beyond the infectious beat and sharp lyricism, “BACKHAND” is ultimately about knowing your worth and making sure people respect it. It’s a theme that resonates far beyond music – whether in business, friendships, or relationships, Ilajide makes it clear that if people aren’t coming correct, they don’t deserve your time or energy.

The song also speaks to the grind of being an independent artist. In an industry where creatives are often underpaid and undervalued, Ilajide flips the script. He’s not here to ask for what’s his – he’s demanding it. And in an era where so many artists struggle to stand out, he’s making sure his presence is impossible to ignore.
